programmes.d: Toni is shocked when Trina and Towanda reveal the truth about Traci's role in the strike; Tamar speaks out on family drama; Towanda hatches a plan to heal the sisterhood; Traci returns from the cattle drive and must perform amidst tense sister drama.
Toni preps to go on her first tour in five years; Tamar struggles through sickness.

After years of broken communication, the Braxtons begin explosive family therapy with Iyanla Vanzant to heal the fractured sisterhood; when things take an unexpected turn, Iyanla calls them out, and it leads to a shocking exit.
Toni is nervous to return to the stage; Trina struggles to redeem herself after a performance falls flat; Tamar shoots a lavish music video.
The sisters return home after touring with Toni; Towanda's 40th birthday brings out her demanding side; Trina collaborates with Gabe on a new business venture.

The Braxtons reveal shocking and surprising confessions to Iyanla Vanzant to heal the broken sisterhood -- including one sister's admission she doesn't like her sisters and another's tearful apology; when pushed too far, Tamar storms off.
